Very stressed out about money and my bills . I feel very disenchanted . I feel tired and depressed and stuck and unsure what to do next . I feel uneasy about the future and uncertain about everything .   I don’t know how many words you are looking for here but it won’t let me send my feelings .

I am feeling calm and relaxed .   Still stressed about money and jobs , but tomorrow is a new day .   Maybe I’ll take control of my life instead of letting it control me .   But we will see .    Also , why are these sentences so long ?   Sheesh . I keep adding on so it will accept my 200 characters . \n

I am currently pretty tired .   I was cleaning my room and my entire metal rolling rack snapped into pieces .   And I don’t have enough clothes to warrant that .   Stupid cheap shit .   Now I have a giant mess in my room and not a spot to put it .

I am feeling like it is super duper cold out and that probably means that I won’t have a lot of customers at the bar tonight .   But I hope I am wrong because I desperately need that cash . And I am going to keep my fingers crossed .

I am currently at work and there is not a customer in sight .   This makes me feel super concerned as to whether or not I will be able to put gas in my car this evening when I leave work .   And that is stressful .

I am feeling pretty ok because all of my customers were very kind to me when tipping me .   That made me feel better .   I made everyone laugh which made me smile .   But it’s still difficult to think about money .

I am currently feeling tired .   I went to bed and slept well until my dog , PERSON , decided it was playtime at five in the morning .   That was fun . Little bugger .   Haha .   I mean , he always gets his way . That’s how it’s supposed to be .

I am in a humongous fight with my fiancé .   He is incarcerated and has not called .   It is super stressful to have limits on times of important conversations .   It definitely has added so many layers of stress and frustration .   I love him .   But he can be a very evil human with his words .   I can too .   But not this time .

I am feeling very nervous about driving in the snow .   It is about to be a blizzard and I drive an hour to get to work .   I am sitting here with a coworker bitching about the weather and we both are feeling ready to leave .

I am feeling very defeated .   Today work was busy for the servers but slow for me .   I ended up leaving in the middle of the snow storm .    I got home just fine , but I am just feeling very awful .    Nothing seems to be going right .

I am feeling tired and cold .   Today is a blizzard and I was supposed to work a double .   So that means no money for me .   This is the fifth Saturday in a row something has happened to make it so that I was unable to work .   Sucks .

Well it is still snowing so I am feeling a little bit homebound .   My neighbor came over on his four wheeler and plowed me out and I helped shoveling but the snow is over my knees so it was a bit taxing .   I feel accomplished though .   And now my dad doesn’t have to worry .

I am feeling exhausted .   I have been shoveling and making things with my neighbor for the majority of the day .   I am currently watching a new show and I think I may become obsessed .   So that’s fun .   A purpose is always fun .

I am feeling like I really need to get some things accomplished today .   I should have used yesterday , while being snowed in , as an excuse to do stuff .   But I did not .   So today I need to get my ass in gear .

I am currently feeling extremely frustrated .   I am being accused of things that are not true , and then having to argue my way out of them being fact .   It is the weirdest situation .   I am literally arguing a version of me that is not actually real .    My fiancé thinks I am a heathen .   And that is just not ever going to be the truth .

I am feeling frustrated because my fiancé is still calling me out of my name .   It is impossible to defend oneself over nonsense that someone else is portraying as fact .   He’s an asshole .   And I feel like punching him in the probates .   But he’s in jail .   So I can’t .

I am feeling a little tired .   I could not sleep last night at all .   I think I finally fell asleep around 6 in the morning and got up at 8 : 30 .   Not all that ideal .   Today I am going to consign some clothes and hit the bank .

I am feeling extremely defeated .    I drive almost an hour away to sell my brand new clothing , hoping to make maybe like $50 .    They took one hoodie , a pair of sweats and a jacket and gave me seven dollars and sixty three cents .   That’s not even enough to cover the gas it took one way !   Ugh .   I am so broke .

I am currently feeling defeated .   Like , not one thing can ever go my way .   I think that’s why I just am so defeatist - because - when I try my best - I am always always always disappointed .   I am such a positive human to the rest of the world - I wish that they could see how badly I truly struggle daily .

I am feeling very tired today .   It is a rainy day and it’s melting the blizzard down to a manageable level , but it is foggy and the air is thick .   It is one of those chicken soup and a book type of days .   But I have to work .   Hopefully I make one million dollars .

I am getting ready to walk into work .   It is still raining .   Apparently it is not supposed to stop until Saturday but turn into ice sleet and snow .   I hate winter .   Hopefully tonight will be lucrative .   Sayin a prayer to the bartender gods .

I am feeling exhausted .   It was an ok night but the customers were so needy !   Hahah .   I am never satisfied .   My fiancé hasn’t called me all day - and the one time he did i had 4 customers sit and like 3 drink tickets come thru so I had to be brief and that sucked .   Waiting for him to call me back at present .   Just pulled into my driveway .   I’m beat .   All encompassing .

I am currently at work and I am feeling ok .   I really am ready to go home .   It is icky out and I only have two customers .   I guess it could be worse .   I could have none .   I am feeling ready to go .   I am feeling broke .   But tomorrow is another day .   Full \ nOf promise .   (Insert sarcasm here)

I am about to have a video chat with my incarcerated fiancée .   He always uses leaving me as an option .   I am over it .   I am feeling sad , overwhelmed , empowered and totally fucking useless .   It’s an impossible situation all of a sudden - and it’s just him trying to make me feel like I am wrong…and me not agreeing .   \n \ nI feel like this is my daily journal entry and I should say : thank you for coming to my ted talk .   \nSo there .   I did .

I am working a private event and it is very boring .   I picked up the night shift and I am hoping it will be busy and I will make a bunch of money .   I’m very optimistic because we have many reservations and it seems like we are about to be popping .

I   am feeling exhausted .   I worked 15 hours yesterday .   The restaurant was bought out during lunch for a private event which was super boring .   But the . We opened up to the public again at dinner time .   We were so busy it was ridiculous .   I felt super accomplished last night after we were busy and came home and counted my tips and felt even better .

I am feeling tired .   I am feeling hungry .   I am feeling cold .   I am feeling like I hate winter .   I am feeling like I need to clean my room today because I m living in a messy room and it is driving me crazy .

It is a really crummy day so I am just beat .   I am so not a winter person .   I have seasonal affective disorder so the lack of sun makes me depressed and dull .   How many more weeks until summer ?   Because I am feeling like it can be that time any time now .

It’s been a long day .   I have spent the majority waiting in other people .   Which becomes frustrating when their technology malfunctions and you have to spend three hours waiting for a mic o soft teams meeting because you don’t know how to troubleshoot .

I am very tired and would like to take a nap .   I am going to spend today cleaning my room once I get some motivation .   Haha .   I have been saying this for Months . One of these days though .   Will today be the day ?

My bank account went negative overnight .   Unsure how .   I am feeling very defeated after having an awesome Saturday shift .   I don’t even go out so I am unsure what has happened .   I guess creditors were trying continuously to hit my account ?   Unsure .   But I’m back to being broke .   Again .

I am just pretty tired .   Ran around to all sorts of banks .   Fucking ORG   I am still so pissed about .   What bank charges you to cash their checks ?   And eight   mother fucking dollars ?    I think that is absolutely criminal .   And I will be getting that mi why PERSON  . Watch me work .
